cushion_shadow.model: max(old, 1 - 0.30 exp(-d / 7 px)), d = distance from the left cushion's alpha; feathered 6 px; below its bottom unchanged

throw.how: per column: the throw's lower R = max(90, 4 d) px stretched over R + d (premultiplied RGBA, bilinear), so its cut edge lies d px lower, MARGIN px behind Olia's top; d smoothed along x (dilate 9, Gaussian 3, never under the need)
